coordinate_system: LCDD world x horizontal, y vertical, z downstream; units mm. Beam line is tilted +30.52 mrad about y in nominal HPS world coordinates.
rotation_convention: Local-to-parent is transpose of Rz(z) Ry(y) Rx(x), composed recursively.
scope: Active silicon geometry only; excludes field, material, dead channels, trigger, reconstruction and selection. Selected 2015/2016 detector versions are representative, not verified source-dataset alignment conditions.

2015.name: HPS-EngRun2015-Nominal-v6-0-fieldmap
2015.vertex_status: Assumed nominal origin; no target volume in LCDD. 2021 local HPSTR SLIC jobs explicitly set target_z=0; transverse zero and 2015/2016 origins are study assumptions.
2015.lcd_header_comment: HPS detector for 2015 Engineering Run. Start from version v1 with optical survey Curved + straight tracks Order of sensor floating: u translations, w translations, u-v-w rotations, global alignment tuning impact parameters central values (remember: z offsets must change sign!) best alignment version for 2015 data as of 170214
2015.station_convention: Geometry module number; L1..L6 are physical stations 1..6.

2016.name: HPS-PhysicsRun2016-Pass2
2016.vertex_status: Assumed nominal origin; no target volume in LCDD. 2021 local HPSTR SLIC jobs explicitly set target_z=0; transverse zero and 2015/2016 origins are study assumptions.
2016.lcd_header_comment: HPS detector for 2016 Physics Run with correctly unfolded 2.3GeV field Uses SVT mechanical survey, SVT opening angle corrections plus millepede internal alignment. Global +1 mm shift in y Correction on top and bottom Layers 1-3 opening angle Millepede internal alignment (iterations: 3-4-5TB tu + 2TB tu + 3-4TB tu + 3-4TB rw +1-6TB tu + 3-4TB tu+rw) Corresponds to version #31
2016.station_convention: Geometry module number; L1..L6 are physical stations 1..6.

2021.name: HPS_Run2021Pass2FEE
2021.vertex_status: Assumed nominal origin; no target volume in LCDD. 2021 local HPSTR SLIC jobs explicitly set target_z=0; transverse zero and 2015/2016 origins are study assumptions.
2021.lcd_header_comment: HPS detector for 2021 run with fieldmap, Tracker at nominal opening angle, no SVT survey, this detector uses the corrected fieldmap scaled to -1.022T for 3.7 GeV. Includes L0 and Hodoscope. ECAL with survey alignment for HPSEcal3 (global y/z translations). This detector has the full hierarchical alignment structure
2021.station_convention: Geometry module number; L1 represents physical L0, L2 upgraded L1; L3..L7 correspond to old L2..L6.
